rules.statement: Mere lapse of time does not deprive a purchaser at a Fiscal's sale of the right to ask for a conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is now settled law-see the case of Arnolis v. Sutia [(1910) 7 Tamb. 64.] -that mere lapse of time does not deprive a purchaser at a Fiscal's sale of the right to ask for a conveyance."
